scope: joint includes all method-response windows; never sum across levels. Method-response windows include the response that records prior primary review, issues method and presents final image, not the model response later reviewing that image. They exclude startup, initial grounding, click preparation, final primary review/close and shared construction; not complete task costs or isolated tool/image attribution.
confounds: fixed order, evolving context/cache, application incidental pixels and joint preparation; no causal route/model savings established
excluded: commentary before first inspection; prior diagnostic turns; current accounting/publication after previous verifier. Exclusion is not zero cost.
preparation_failure: joint includes comparison01 test import failure, erroneous unfrozen launch and cleanup; successor02 all four cases retained
